hero.title: In Every Skill, We Find a Unique Story, and in Every Story, We Find Purpose
hero.description: Nepal's first local gig marketplace. Find quick jobs near you or hire skilled locals for everyday tasks. From fan repairs to home services - earn extra income or get things done with trusted neighbors.

items.question: What is NepalKamma?
items.answer: NepalKamma is a local job platform that connects talent with opportunities nearby. We focus on building trust and integrity.

items.question: How do I apply for a job?
items.answer: Simply browse jobs, use the advanced search, or check nearby jobs. Once you find a suitable opportunity, click on the job to apply, it directly sends message to the job provider.

items.question: Can I post a job as a provider?
items.answer: Yes! Job providers can post jobs, manage applications, and connect directly with local talent.

items.question: Is NepalKamma free to use?
items.answer: Document verification is required and is free. Job seekers can browse and apply for jobs at no cost, while providers can access additional features for advanced visibility and tools.

items.question: How do I contact support?
items.answer: You can reach out to us through the 'Connect With Us' section in the footer or by emailing support@nepalkamma.com.
